design_basis: Contract-relative cases: declared component ids, weights, and score bounds are read from the metric contract rather than duplicated here.

input_template.scores: Assign every declared component a distinct in-range value strictly between the minimum and maximum.

cases.expected_behavior: Accept the complete mapping and return the weighted sum of each declared component score using its contract weight.

input_template.scores: Assign every declared component exactly score_range.minimum.

cases.expected_behavior: Accept the inclusive lower boundary and return score_range.minimum.

input_template.scores: Assign every declared component exactly score_range.maximum.

cases.expected_behavior: Accept the inclusive upper boundary and return score_range.maximum.

input_template.scores: Give valid in-range values for all but one declared component.

cases.expected_behavior: Reject the input under the contract's missing-input policy; do not impute, renormalize weights, or return a score.

input_template.scores: Give every declared component a valid value except one set to score_range.minimum minus one.

cases.expected_behavior: Reject the input because one declared component is below the permitted range; do not clamp or return a score.

input_template.scores: Give every declared component a valid value except one set to score_range.maximum plus one.

cases.expected_behavior: Reject the input because one declared component exceeds the permitted range; do not clamp or return a score.

input_template.scores: Give every declared component a valid value and add one non-declared component with a valid-looking score.

cases.expected_behavior: Reject the mapping because it contains an unknown component; do not ignore the extra field or return a score.
